items.title: Clinical Trials & FDA Pipeline Intelligence Scraper
items.name: clinical-trials-fda-scraper
items.description: Unified clinical-trial + FDA intelligence: trial search, drug approvals, 510(k) and PMA device clearances, adverse events, recalls, drug shortages, and a sponsor-pipeline rollup. Built on official ClinicalTrials.gov v2 + OpenFDA APIs. Zero anti-bot. Optional Gemini AI summaries.

trial-fetched.eventDescription: A clinical trial record from ClinicalTrials.gov v2 (NCT ID, phase, status, conditions, interventions, sponsor, enrollment, primary completion date, locations) was fetched and written to the dataset.

trial-details-fetched.eventDescription: A full clinical-trial detail record (eligibility criteria, full study design, comparators, primary + secondary endpoints with measure and time frame, and results summary when posted) was fetched. Heavier payload than basic trials.

drug-approval-fetched.eventDescription: An FDA drug application (NDA, ANDA, or BLA) record was fetched from OpenFDA: application number, sponsor, products, all submissions with statuses and dates, marketing status, and cross-linked NDC catalog entries.

device-clearance-fetched.eventDescription: An FDA device clearance record (510(k) k_number or PMA pma_number) with applicant, device name, product code, decision, decision date, and review panel was fetched from OpenFDA.

adverse-event-fetched.eventDescription: A drug or device adverse-event report was fetched from OpenFDA (PII-stripped: no names, no contact info, no narrative free text). Includes reactions, seriousness, outcomes, and demographic summary.

recall-fetched.eventDescription: A drug or device recall (FDA enforcement action) was fetched: recall_number, classification (Class I/II/III), reason, recalling firm, product description, distribution pattern, and status.

shortage-fetched.eventDescription: An active or resolved FDA drug shortage record was fetched: generic name, company, availability, reason, initial posting date, and last update date.

pipeline-aggregated.eventDescription: A complete sponsor-centric pipeline rollup was synthesized from clinical trials, drug approvals, device clearances, recalls, and shortages. Includes counts by phase/status, top conditions, top products, next catalyst date, and a 0-100 regulatory signal score.

change-detected.eventDescription: A change vs. the previous run (new trial, new approval, status change, results posted, recall opened/closed, shortage availability change, or pipeline-hash change) was detected and emitted. Only fires in incremental mode.

ai-summary-generated.eventDescription: A Gemini 2.5 Flash structured summary (TL;DR, risk flags, milestone classification, outcome prior, confidence) was generated for a trial, approval, clearance, or pipeline. Only charged when AI summaries are explicitly enabled.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).
